snippet.title: .curator Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4107960/curator

From a world imagined by acclaimed SF writer Richard K. Morgan comes .curator - an episodic sci-fi detective thriller where the future is not a prophecy. It is a draft.

You are The .Curator. With C.R.I.S.S.I., you can glimpse what is about to happen - and rewrite it. Choose your path. Decide who lives and who dies. Turn your enemies into stepping stones toward saving the world.

Every foresight is a choice. Every choice leaves a scar.

Story written in full by Richard K. Morgan (Altered Carbon)
Episodic detective adventure - Season 1 is written in full
Branching investigations with permanent consequences
C.R.I.S.S.I.: see the future, then change it

#curator #RichardKMorgan #SciFi #NarrativeGame
